description: Decode one or more US medical codes to their official descriptions across ICD-10-CM (diagnoses), ICD-10-PCS (inpatient procedures), HCPCS Level II (supplies/drugs/services), and RxNorm (drugs, by RXCUI). Also decodes a National Drug Code (NDC) directly to its RxNorm product offline, tagged `source: "NDC"` — hyphenated in an FDA segment configuration (4-4-2, 5-3-2, 5-4-1, or the 11-digit 5-4-2) or as bare 10/11 digits; any other segment widths are malformed and stay unresolved. Auto-detects the system from each code's shape, and a code written in ICD-10-CM dotted form (`A01.00`) resolves to ICD-10-CM; pass an explicit `system` only when a value is genuinely ambiguous. Accepts 1–50 codes and returns partial success: resolved codes in `found`, unresolved in `notFound` with a per-code reason, so one bad code never fails the batch. Each reply holds `structuredContent` and the text to 24,000 bytes apiece: codes are decoded in request order, and once one has resolved, a code that would carry the reply past that budget is returned unprocessed in `deferred`, as sent, with every code after it — re-call with `codes` set to `deferred` and the same `system` and `includeHierarchy` until no `deferred` comes back. Three kinds of code are never deferred and can carry a reply past the budget: the first code that resolves, returned whole; the codes before it; and the unresolved codes after the last one that resolves, so a re-call always holds a code that resolves. Only a batch where nothing resolves fails: with ambiguous_system and `candidateSystems` when every code exists in more than one bundled system, otherwise with no_codes_found. Set `includeHierarchy` to attach each code's parent and immediate children (with a `childrenTruncated` flag when a code has more children than the cap returns — walk the full set via medcode_map_codes, or medcode_browse_hierarchy outside ICD-10-PCS); an ICD-10-PCS table row's children are the complete codes that begin with it. The resolved `system` is echoed on every result for chaining into a billability check or a medcode_map_codes parents/children walk; a bare integer that resolves nowhere is named as a possible CPT / HCPCS Level I code, which is out of scope, except a bare 10/11-digit one, which is named as an NDC no bundled drug maps to; a dotted all-digit value in ICD-9-CM form (`250.00`) is never read as an RXCUI and is named as ICD-9-CM, which is not bundled; an ICD-10-PCS section value from medcode_browse_hierarchy (`0`) looked up under system ICD10PCS is named as a section, not a code; a code string that also exists in another bundled system carries `alsoInSystems` naming it, so a single answer to a colliding code is never mistaken for the only one.

codes.description: Codes to decode (1–50). Mixed systems are fine — each is detected independently. An NDC decodes to its RxNorm product: hyphenated as 4-4-2, 5-3-2, 5-4-1, or 5-4-2, or as bare 10/11 digits.

items.description: A single code to decode (with or without dots), an RXCUI, or an NDC. Must not be blank or whitespace-only.

includeHierarchy.description: When true, attach each found code's parent and immediate children.

system.description: Force every code to be looked up in this system, which also skips the NDC decode. Omit to auto-detect per code.

name: medcode_get_code

deferred.description: Input codes not processed because the reply reached its byte budget, in request order and as sent. Re-call with these as codes and the same system and includeHierarchy, until no deferred comes back. Absent when every code was processed.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_codes_found`: None of the requested codes resolved — in any bundled system, or in the explicit `system` when one is given. The message names each code another bundled system holds and each code present in more than one system, with those systems, and each ICD-10-PCS section value, bare integer, value in ICD-9-CM form, and NDC among the misses. `ambiguous_system`: Every requested code is present in more than one bundled system and no `system` was given; `candidateSystems` lists the union of those systems. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

found.description: Successfully decoded codes, in request order.

items.description: A decoded code, optionally with its parent/children and resolution source.

alsoInSystems.description: Other bundled systems holding this same code string, present only when there is at least one. The result above is the system this code resolved in; the code is a DIFFERENT code in each system listed here — "B00" is the ICD-10-CM category "Herpesviral [herpes simplex] infections" and also the ICD-10-PCS table row "Imaging, Central Nervous System, Plain Radiography". Re-call with `system` set to one of these values to decode it there.

billable.description: True when the code is a billable leaf. False for headers/categories, non-billable codes, and HCPCS codes whose last valid date has passed. Null when the system has no billing concept (RxNorm).

chapter.description: Chapter/range bucket the code belongs to, or null when not applicable. For RxNorm, the concept term type (IN, PIN, MIN, BN, SCD, SBD, GPCK, BPCK).

children.description: Immediate child codes (present only when includeHierarchy is true). For an ICD-10-PCS table row, the complete codes that begin with it.

items.description: A decoded code with its official descriptions and derived flags.

billable.description: True when the code is a billable leaf. False for headers/categories, non-billable codes, and HCPCS codes whose last valid date has passed. Null when the system has no billing concept (RxNorm).

chapter.description: Chapter/range bucket the code belongs to, or null when not applicable. For RxNorm, the concept term type (IN, PIN, MIN, BN, SCD, SBD, GPCK, BPCK).

code.description: The resolved code in display form (ICD-10-CM codes carry the dot, e.g. "E11.9").

description.description: Official long description (falls back to the short description when no long form exists).

header.description: True when the code is a non-billable header with codes below it — an ICD-10-CM category, a HCPCS range bucket, or a three-character ICD-10-PCS table row — rather than a leaf code.

shortDescription.description: Official short/abbreviated description, or null when none is on record. Always null for RxNorm, which publishes a single name.

system.description: The system that answered: "ICD10CM", "ICD10PCS", "HCPCS", or "RXNORM". Pass it as `system` to medcode_check_code, or to medcode_map_codes on a parents/children walk; the map_codes drug directions accept only "RXNORM", which they need no `system` to reach.

childrenTruncated.description: True when the code has more immediate children than `children` carries — the list was capped at the server cap (present only when includeHierarchy is true). Retrieve the full child list with medcode_map_codes (children) for this code, passing its `system`, or medcode_browse_hierarchy outside ICD-10-PCS.

code.description: The resolved code in display form (ICD-10-CM codes carry the dot, e.g. "E11.9").

description.description: Official long description (falls back to the short description when no long form exists).

header.description: True when the code is a non-billable header with codes below it — an ICD-10-CM category, a HCPCS range bucket, or a three-character ICD-10-PCS table row — rather than a leaf code.

parent.description: Immediate parent code, always one medcode_get_code decodes (present only when includeHierarchy is true): an ICD-10-CM code padded with the placeholder X names the nearest code above the padding (`S82.66XA` → `S82.66`), and a complete ICD-10-PCS code names its three-character table row (`0DTJ4ZZ` → `0DT`). Null at a root — an ICD-10-CM category, a HCPCS range bucket, an ICD-10-PCS table row — and for RxNorm.

shortDescription.description: Official short/abbreviated description, or null when none is on record. Always null for RxNorm, which publishes a single name.

source.description: Resolution provenance when the input was not a direct code: "NDC" when an NDC was decoded to its RxNorm product via the NDC↔RxNorm map. Omitted for direct code lookups.

system.description: The system that answered: "ICD10CM", "ICD10PCS", "HCPCS", or "RXNORM". Pass it as `system` to medcode_check_code, or to medcode_map_codes on a parents/children walk; the map_codes drug directions accept only "RXNORM", which they need no `system` to reach.

notFound.description: Codes that did not resolve, with per-code reasons.

items.description: An input code that did not resolve, with the reason it failed.

candidateSystems.description: When ambiguous, the systems whose shape/content the code matched — re-call with one as `system`.

code.description: The input code that could not be resolved.

reason.description: Why it could not be resolved (absent from every bundled system — for a bare integer, with a note that CPT / HCPCS Level I codes are out of scope, and for a dotted all-digit value in ICD-9-CM form such as "250.00", with a note that ICD-9-CM is not bundled — absent from the explicit `system` while another bundled system holds it, which is named, an ICD-10-PCS section value looked up as a code under system ICD10PCS, which is named as that section, a well-formed NDC nothing maps to, hyphenated or as bare 10/11 digits, an NDC looked up under an explicit `system` that skips the NDC decode, or ambiguous across systems).

title: Get Medical Code
